title: Variants, version 1
description: Named, composable edits to a story's text, kept in the story folder as variants.json. A variant is applied to the rendered text of an edition (what a reader meets), never to the records, so the text a test saw is reproducible from the variant's name; scripts/story-variants.mjs renders it, shows the difference, and writes the winner back into the records as tokens (apply). Every string is a token source: a name is {{id}}, and it is resolved before the phrase is looked for in the text. Field reference: docs/3-reference/VARIANTS-AND-THE-APPLIED-RECORD.md. Keys starting with _ are notes anywhere and are never checked.

variants.description: Variants keyed by name (lower-case letters, digits and hyphens). The name base is reserved: it means the text as the records render it. Names compose on the command line with +: rest-the-workshop+night-in-the-time-line applies the steps of the first, then the second.

about.description: One line for a person: what this variant tests.

steps.description: The edits, in order. Each step is one of: { "replace": "<phrase>", "with": "<phrase>", "in": "<slug>" | "every spread" | "one spread" }; { "drop": ["<slug>", ...] }; { "banner": "<one line>" }; { "add": "new-<slug>", "after" | "before": "<slug>", "draft": { title, picture, time, paragraphs, dialogue, part, margin_note, margin_author, footnote } }. The loader checks each step's shape and says what is wrong.
